upwork_profile.project_title_70_chars: Full-Stack Inventory Management System with RBAC, Invoicing & PDF
upwork_profile.role_100_chars: Full-Stack Developer — Angular 17 frontend, Node.js/Express API, PostgreSQL
upwork_profile.description_600_chars:
Designed and built a complete Inventory Management System (InvenTrack) from scratch. Frontend is Angular 17 (standalone components, lazy routing, RBAC guards, HTTP interceptor); backend is a Node.js/Express REST API on PostgreSQL (Supabase) using JWT auth, bcrypt, role-based permissions, and nodemailer.

Core modules: Products, Categories, Warehouses, Vendors, Customers, Stocks, Purchase Orders, Deliveries, and Invoices — each with paginated CRUD and keyword search. Orders auto-increase stock, deliveries auto-decrease it.

Key features I delivered:
• Granular RBAC: roles, modules, per-module view/create/update/delete permissions, super-admin bypass
• Auth flow with first-login OTP via Gmail SMTP (bcrypt-hashed, 10-min expiry)
• Invoice builder with subtotal/discount/tax/total math and server-side PDFKit generation (branded A4 invoice)
• Dashboard charts (ng2-charts) for orders/deliveries KPIs
• Secure transactions (BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK) for invoice line items
• Schema migrations, seed script, and reference-data pagination utils

Result: a production-grade, multi-tenant-ready system replacing manual spreadsheet tracking.
